description: Deterministic index of named declarations in cosmo-bde (generators, application, generated code, scripts) with per-directory submanifests. Search here before adding a function.
coverage_rules: Includes C/C++ functions, prototypes, types and #define macros; shell functions; Python functions/classes; SQL DDL.
Excludes third-party trees under `vendors/` (submodules and single-file libraries), build output (`build/`, `o/`) and `.github/`.
Regenerate with `python3 .github/ci-kit/manifest-gen.py .`; CI fails if the committed manifests drift (`.github/ci-kit/drift-gate.sh`).
directory_notes: Search this submanifest before adding new functions in this directory.
Prefer Cosmopolitan libc facilities (cosmo.h: IsWindows/IsXnu/IsLinux, ShowCrashReports, pledge/unveil) over new platform code.
